name: Admin creates a new household entry
description: An RT administrator adds a new household to the master directory and verifies it appears in the table.

planSteps.description: Click the 'Tambah Data Rumah' button to open the modal
Type 'D-18' into the house number input field
Type 'Bambang Trihatmodjo' into the head of family name input field
Submit the household form by clicking 'Simpan Data Warga'
Verify the household table displays 'Bambang Trihatmodjo' and house number 'D-18' with a generated access code
